title:
Represent run of a workflow that executes Python `async def` coroutines asynchronously.

Usage:
```python
async def _generate_async(model, prompts):
  await asyncio.sleep(1)
  return prompt + "resp"

def process(...):
  c3.MlOperationRun(run=c3.SimpleAsynchronousPyRun.start(_generate_async(model, prompts)),
                    opName=[c3.MlDataOpName.ASYNC_PROCESS])
```

This can be useful in persisted python executes.
Please note that opName should be mandatory set to `c3.MlDataOpName.ASYNC_PROCESS`.
name: SimpleAsynchronousPyRun
